title: LLM inference serving, Part 1: prefill vs decode
tldr: What happens inside an LLM server for one request: tokens and the one-token-at-a-time loop, the prefill pass over the whole prompt and the decode loop after it, why prefill is compute-bound and decode is memory-bandwidth-bound (arithmetic intensity and the roofline, with H100, H200 and A100 numbers), TTFT, TPOT, ITL and throughput and the phase behind each, a roofline calculator and a tested estimator script, why one-request-at-a-time serving collapses under load, prefill-decode interference, choosing hardware and metrics per workload, and an interview drill.
